records.title: Classical baseline · θ = 1
records.method: Absolute convergence of the Euler products gives nonvanishing of the Riemann zeta function and every Dirichlet L-function for Re(s) > 1. This is the classical starting bound; quasi-RH asks for a fixed boundary strictly below 1.

records.title: Akash Levy · weighted numerator
records.method: Replaces the pointwise numerator bound in the cubic-theta probe of OpenAI's argument by a weighted fourth moment of the reflected physical numerator: Mellin inversion and the Hecke functional equation reduce the actual smoothed numerator sum to a plain polynomial of length at most U/Y, and the unused length carries selected prime factors in the original fourth moment, while a coefficient-norm argument controls the original Euler correction and its ramified error terms. The moment parameter stays at the original kappa = 3/4; with ell = 167/1000, theta = 11/12 - ell/4 = 10499/12000, and the finite exponent comparisons are exact rational certificates. Lean 4.34.1 development of 228 modules on the akashlevy/math fork (c388e88e6) of OpenAI/math fd4aeeb, with Mathlib d13f23b7; it proves zeta, all-Dirichlet and finite-order Hecke nonvanishing for Re s > 10499/12000.

records.title: Cycle61 with the affine moment in the detector count
records.method: Builds on Hailey Collet's Cycle61 (874861/1000000). Cycle61's initial affine moment (Theorem 2.2), previously used only in the source row, is also applied in the detector's per-fiber count. For plain lengths m in [0.4137, 0.4235], the marked plain capacity (1-2m)/(6κ) becomes (B-2m)/Λ. On the critical region δ ∈ [0.445, 0.485], p ∈ [0.495, 0.5], this replaces Cycle25's countingR κ* by a κ-independent closed form and moves the endpoint to 437423/500000 with h = 15903/20000. The detector moment is supplied by Cycle61's generic paid main and error families at each dictionary character, with heights chosen per character. All other estimates are Cycle61's, rechecked at the new endpoint with exact rational certificates. AI disclosure: DaysSky with Claude assistance.
